calls.title: Review of new AI messaging on home page
calls.summary: The team discussed updating the homepage with AI messaging, focusing on using screenshots of AI skills for safe rollouts and ramp schedules to provide visual product proof. Key participants included Elyse Fox (lead), Scott Bailey (engineering), Growthbook Dorn (product), and Karen Henke (marketing). Next steps: Scott will create a simplified screenshot of a safe rollout prompt, Karen will share updated copy and fix a broken feature flag image, and the team will iterate on headlines via the marketing channel.

calls.title: Review of new AI messaging on home page
calls.summary: The team finalized the headline 'Build smarter ship safely grow at the speed of AI', prioritizing execution speed while remaining open to future revisions. They decided to enhance product visuals by simplifying existing screenshots and integrating AI elements to better showcase capabilities. The messaging around experimentation was refined to highlight AI's role in accelerating results while emphasizing practical outcomes, with the agreement to retain 'Faster Results, Bigger Impact' as a core headline. Discussions on feature flag creation focused on separating roles of creation and monitoring. The inclusion of customer stories was emphasized to illustrate AI's impact, alongside a need for technical adjustments to improve live site content clarity.
calls.keywords: AI messaging, homepage redesign, feature flags, safe rollout, product analytics, customer testimonials
